player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I included a placeholder `[address]` but did not provide the required three distinct sections of highlighted text using markdown (e.g., `*text*` or `**text**`). Although I used italics for terms like *kami*, these were not structural sections. Next time, I will explicitly divide my lecture into three clear parts (e.g., "The Sacred Interior," "The Approach and Purification," and "The Spiritual Significance") and ensure each entire section is wrapped in markdown highlighting syntax, while still including the mandatory placeholder `[address]` within the text.
